title: LADA R vs LADA Y, Sep 28
notes: Home game at Renton against LADA Y, LADA's other team: we wore white with blue numbers on the right (home) bench, LADA Y light blue. The video came as 3246x1440 and was scaled up to Renton's usual 3840x1702. The same video was processed for LADA Y's site; our white jersey's test excluded light blue ("white vs light blue"), since 9% of LADA Y's torsos passed the plain white test.

Periods from the arena scoreboard: 0:23-18:37, 20:13-38:14 and 39:48-65:42 of the video (the empty-ice proposal found a single period). The board ran a 1:00 intermission countdown after the 1st and the 2nd. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Willis #35 was in our net, the right one in the 1st and 3rd, the left in the 2nd.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video by the scoreboard and checked by eye: LADA Y's at 5:12 (clock 13:05, 1st, #37 Akulov) and 16:08 (2:05, 1st, #97 Barkov); ours at 26:49 (11:15, 2nd, Moshchuk #57 from Sergeev #12) and 46:58 (12:28, 3rd, Moshchuk #57 from Sergeev #12 and Shtin #64; his number wasn't readable at the goal, so the sheet's credit stands). Final 2-2.
Shots on goal from the board: LADA R 22, LADA Y 31 (4-14, 6-7, 12-10 by period). SportNinja's sheet has LADA Y at 32 (11 in the 3rd).

Penalty: Bogdanov #10 hooking with 0:30 left in the 1st (whistle at 17:44 of the video, in the box at 17:49). The board ran 3:00, so 2:31 of it carried into the 2nd, the last 76 s 4 on 4 after LADA Y's #78 went off for tripping. LADA Y also had #70 Lisitsyn's slashing with 1:18 left; 0:42 of that power play remained at the final horn.

Played: 13 skaters. Shikhanov #70 and Shachak #92 played all game though the sheet has them as not playing (SHIKHANOV 70 and SHACHAK 92 on their backs). Didn't play: Belousenko #11, Vorobyov #39, Shanygin #72, Fateev #80 and Perry #99 (the sheet agrees). Moshchuk #57's number was rarely readable, so the reviewers were told he played all game.

No review rows were labeled by hand. Three lineup stretches were checked in full frames and fixed with on/off entries: P1 16:00-16:09 (Shanygin #8 on for LADA Y's second goal), P3 46:39-47:13 (#8 off: the five on for our second goal were #12, #57, #64, #70 and #79) and P3 62:50-63:37 (Moshchuk #57 on, #8 off, during the power play).

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 13:05: LADA Y's #37 Akulov pokes it in from a scramble at the crease, 0-1
1st period, clock 2:05: LADA Y's #97 Barkov drives in on the goalie and scores, 0-2
2nd period, clock 11:15: Moshchuk #57 cuts in and shoots, 1-2
3rd period, clock 12:28: Moshchuk #57 again, from a scramble at the crease, 2-2
1st period, clock 0:30: hooking; the board ran 3:00, 2:31 of it carried into the 2nd (4 on 4 for 76 s)
